bioAdditions: Ralph's draft card gives his full name as Ralph Anthony Cognetti. When he registered on 16 October 1940 he and his new wife lived at 1506 Farr Street in Scranton, and he worked for the Royal Bottling Company on Wyoming Avenue; he was 5 ft 7 in, 145 lb, with blue eyes and brown hair (S1). Six months earlier the census had found him at home on Philo Street, a 27-year-old truck driver for a beverage firm who had finished eighth grade (S2). He married Marguerite Forgione on 1 June 1940; the priest, Rev. Luigino R[angi?] of 1402 Short Avenue, also married his brother Sal three years later (S3). In 1950 Ralph was a salesman for a beer distributor, earning $3,000 a year, with four children at home, and the census notes that he had not served in the Second World War (S4).
